statement: The study excluded currently high-grade ACR, pAMR >=1 and treated rejection from study biopsies, then analyzed stromal morphology over time against prior inflammatory histories and subsequent allograft-loss/CAV outcomes.
supports: Supports a separate longitudinal tissue-remodeling question using biopsies without current serious rejection, conditional on dated clinical outcomes.
does_not_establish: Not a validated predictor of current ACR or proof that local negative biopsies contain rejection. Outcome-selected features and associations are not independent held-out predictive performance.
method_or_result: 210 stromal features, with mixed-effects analysis of patient/time trajectories and outcome-associated selection of five features.

statement: The authors report limited routine AMR immunostaining and historical diagnostic-label variability; the cohort is single-center and the analysis links repeated biopsies to patient-level outcomes.
supports: Supports explicit separation of complete pAMR confirmation, histologic findings, historical rejection labels and clinical outcomes in SMC.
does_not_establish: No causal effect of immunosuppression changes or external clinical validation. Composite CAV severity is written as >=2 in cohort methods but >2 elsewhere; no exact event-rate or threshold claim is indexed.
method_or_result: 210 stromal features, with mixed-effects analysis of patient/time trajectories and outcome-associated selection of five features.

statement: CONCH pretraining aligns histopathology images and captions; downstream supervised WSI classification uses pretrained tile features with ABMIL, whereas ROI classification uses logistic regression.
supports: Supports testing a frozen representation with a small task-specific classifier, while distinguishing patch representation changes from slide aggregation changes.
does_not_establish: No cardiac rejection, cardiac IHC or SMC improvement established. ROI logistic regression is not a tested mean-pooled cardiac event model. Reviewed source is 2023 v2, not final 2024 paper or CONCHv1.5.
method_or_result: Contrastive image-text alignment and captioning; frozen features with ABMIL for WSI supervised classification and logistic regression for ROI classification; text similarity and top-K pooling for zero-shot WSI.

statement: The CONCH preprint omits CTransPath from TCGA slide-level comparisons due to possible pretraining/test overlap, and its zero-shot WSI method reports the best pooling K among several choices.
supports: Supports auditing pretraining overlap and fixing pooling/prompt choices using development data before independent evaluation.
does_not_establish: This is not proof that all CTransPath evaluations leak or that CONCH has no overlap. The cited top-K paragraph does not establish an independent selection set; no zero-shot numerical superiority claim is indexed.
method_or_result: Contrastive image-text alignment and captioning; frozen features with ABMIL for WSI supervised classification and logistic regression for ROI classification; text similarity and top-K pooling for zero-shot WSI.

statement: TITAN pretraining includes GTEx alongside clinical pathology and multiple stains, uses CONCHv1.5 patch features, and evaluates fixed slide embeddings with logistic regression and few-shot class prototypes against mean-pooling and ABMIL baselines.
supports: Supports a pretrained slide-representation comparator and an additional mixed clinical/GTEx pretraining precedent relevant to autopsy transfer planning.
does_not_establish: Does not isolate the contribution of GTEx/autopsy material or demonstrate heart rejection benefit. It is not a drop-in pooling layer for current UNI v2 features; patch encoder, physical scale and coordinates must match.
method_or_result: CONCHv1.5 patch features and spatial slide encoder, followed by vision-language alignment. Frozen slide embeddings evaluated with logistic regression, prototypes and other heads.

statement: TITAN includes renal allograft rejection (4847 H&E WSIs from 1118 patients). Its renal dataset paragraph describes label-stratified slide counts, while its survival protocol selects a penalty using the best average test metric across folds.
supports: Provides a noncardiac transplant representation benchmark and concrete validation details to audit before transferring a protocol.
does_not_establish: The renal paragraph alone does not demonstrate patient-disjoint partitions. Renal AMR/cellular rejection is not cardiac ACR/AMR. Survival penalty selection raises model-selection optimism concerns for that analysis, not every TITAN task; no quantitative superiority or independent survival validation claim is indexed.
method_or_result: CONCHv1.5 patch features and spatial slide encoder, followed by vision-language alignment. Frozen slide embeddings evaluated with logistic regression, prototypes and other heads.
